Pool Cleaning & Pool Service Bluestone Pools is a fully licensed and insured pool cleaning and service company that services pools in the Dallas Fort Worth Metroplex. Read More POOL REMODELING Bluestone Pools provides remodeling and renovation services for inground swimming pools, as well as repairs for clients looking to improve their inground swimming pools. Read More Pool Equipment Repair Bluestone Pools repairs swimming pool equipment including pumps, filters, motors, computers, spa blowers, and heaters for our clients. Bluestone also corrects problems with mastic, plumbing and chillers. Read More Concrete Overlays Bluestone Pools offers concrete resurfacing services to help bring a refreshed look to any indoor or outdoor area. We use high-quality concrete overlays that are durable, customizable, and virtually maintenance-free. Our overlays are perfect for pool decks, patios, driveways, sidewalks, and more. With Bluestone Pools’ concrete resurfacing services, our customers can choose from various colors and textures to create the perfect look for their outdoor space. Not only do we provide an aesthetically pleasing look, but our service is also low-cost and long-lasting. We also prioritize safety by ensuring all our surfaces are slip-resistant and adequately sealed against water damage. Bluestone Pools provides a reliable service with excellent results that will keep your concrete floors looking great for years to come! Pool Service Company DFW Metroplex Bluestone Pools was founded in 2014 to provide the highest level of swimming pool cleaning and equipment repair services. Since then, Bluestone Pools has continued to grow in the Northeast Tarrant County area. Bluestone Pools utilizes the latest industry advancements to ensure that all pools are clean, safe, and adequately maintained. With various services, including chemical balancing, pool resurfacing, filtration system repairs, and leak detection and repairs, customers can rest assured their collections will be taken care of. Bluestone Pool’s experienced technicians have undergone extensive training and certifications to ensure all jobs are completed efficiently and safely. Customers benefit from same-day service for most repairs and flexible scheduling options for regular maintenance services from Bluestone Pools. With a customer satisfaction rating of 98%, Bluestone Pools has proven itself the premier swimming pool maintenance provider. We love when our customers refer us to their friends and family. In addition, we have grown our team to be able to tackle any project, no matter how complicated or challenging. Pool Services Near Dallas Fort Worth Metroplex We’re not just a pool cleaning company; we are also a pool service company that services inground swimming pool equipment like pool filters, pumps, heaters, and more. We don’t stop there. We also remodel and renovate swimming pools and spas for clients throughout the DFW Metroplex. Is your pool old and worn out? We can remodel it and even change its shape and add new features. reviews.text:
Brad Cormac and his team of professionals performed a total renovation to our pool including decking expansion, tile, coping, etc. We could not be happier with the results. They were timely, professional, with excellent follow through. We would highly recommend!
I wish I could share the before and after photos.
reviews.author: Karen Moratz

reviews.text: I recently switched to these guys based on a referral and boy has it made a difference. Chris has been fantastic, came in to a pool that required a lot of clean up and work and had it looking perfect within just a couple of days. On top of reconditioning my pool equipment with ease he recognized that my pool cleaner needed maintaining and had it fixed and returned within 1 day!!! I cannot fully express how happy I am with his professionalism and service.  10/10 would recommend.
reviews.author: Cameron Alexander

reviews.text: We recently purchased a home with a pool, and we are first time pool owners. Bluestone has been extremely helpful answering all of our questions and have made taking care of the pool so much easier with their weekly maintenance plans.
reviews.author: Leslie Price

reviews.text: Called and left messages numerous times just to talk with someone about getting a bid for maintenance work.  Their voice message says "we return the call on the same business day"... Nope...
reviews.author: Dave Rawls

reviews.text: Excellent company.  Honest and reasonable rates on pool cleaning and any need pool repairs!
reviews.author: Paul Mason

reviews.text: Great service, reliable, very responsive. I would highly recommend!
reviews.author: George Shawver

reviews.text: Consistent, Great service. Highly recommend Bluestone pools.
reviews.author: Philip Issa
